The movement goes OUT toward the horizon, never a wall of water charging inland. This is a calm impossible slow unfolding, no storm or tsunami. Three small irregular shallow salt-water depressions remain on the newly exposed strip at different distances, surrounded by white saline paper seams. A continuous thin ochre fold passes between them and continues toward low dry coastal hills. On a small bare ridge to the RIGHT, fully within frame and ABOVE the lower title zone, rests ONE small complete empty pale-paper sling: two narrow twisted-paper cords and a shallow folded pouch, no rubber Y-shape. ONE tiny pale faceted paper stone lies on the newly exposed shore nearby, no flight, impact or glow; the action has just ended. The tool and stone together occupy less than one tenth frame width, subordinated to territorial transformation. No people or birds. Far low hills and pale mineral-blue sky occupy the upper third. Salt pools are remnants, not gardens or an oasis. Six distinct real paper depths and warm sideways shadows. No giant decorative sun or circular halo.

No people, hands, birds, mountains, sky, horizon, water body, island map, miniature house, whole landscape, ornamental pattern, circular emblem, shrine, talisman, text or border. Quiet mysterious physical transformation, no glow.
